Compares two rasters of classes of different times, as two land covers, and gives each change from a class to another its own code.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Classes, Transition, Change, Land cover<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterTransitionClasses`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inPreviousRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster of the classes of the previous time. |
| `inNextRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster of the classes of the next time, on the same grid. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The raster of the codes of the transitions. |
| `outTransition` | output file |  | The optional csv table of the transitions: code, previous class, next class and count of cells. |
